title: AWS EKS & Container Compromise Incident Response Playbook
scope: AWS Incident Response Playbook sample for Amazon EKS and container runtime compromise.

source.document_title: AWS EKS & Container Compromise Incident Response Playbook
source.page_or_section: AWS EKS & Container Compromise Incident Response Playbook

steps.activity: Validate GuardDuty EKS Runtime or K8s Audit Log alert
steps.description: Confirm suspicious kubectl exec, privileged container deployment, or anonymous API access.

source_anchor.section: AWS EKS & Container Compromise Incident Response Playbook
source_anchor.quote_or_summary: Confirm suspicious kubectl exec, privileged container deployment, or anonymous API access.

steps.activity: Inspect container image digest, RBAC ClusterRoleBindings, and pod spec
steps.description: Verify ECR image provenance and check for hostPID, hostNetwork, or privileged flags.

source_anchor.section: AWS EKS & Container Compromise Incident Response Playbook
source_anchor.quote_or_summary: Verify ECR image provenance and check for hostPID, hostNetwork, or privileged flags.

steps.activity: Check IMDS/IRSA token abuse and worker node CloudTrail calls
steps.description: Audit CloudTrail for IAM role sessions originating from the compromised pod or EC2 node.

source_anchor.section: AWS EKS & Container Compromise Incident Response Playbook
source_anchor.quote_or_summary: Audit CloudTrail for IAM role sessions originating from the compromised pod or EC2 node.

steps.activity: Apply NetworkPolicy isolation, cordon node, and rotate IRSA/K8s secrets
steps.description: Prevent pod egress, drain compromised worker node, and invalidate exposed tokens.
steps.condition: Triggered when investigation confirms active compromise or operational impact.

source_anchor.section: AWS EKS & Container Compromise Incident Response Playbook
source_anchor.quote_or_summary: Prevent pod egress, drain compromised worker node, and invalidate exposed tokens.

steps.activity: Redeploy verified clean workloads and close container incident
steps.description: Document Pod Security Standards enforcement and post-incident review.

source_anchor.quote_or_summary: Document Pod Security Standards enforcement and post-incident review.
